findings.failing_input: On 2026-05-24 Asia/Jerusalem, rows include one early MTD completed day 2026-05-03 with revenue 10000, spend 0, cogs 2500, hasCogs true, plus seven completed baseline days 2026-05-17..2026-05-23 with revenue 1000/day, spend 0, cogs 100/day, hasCogs true, no fixed costs. This is realistic when early-month store/product mix had 25% COGS and the last completed week has 10% COGS.
findings.expected: projectedNet should preserve actual MTD costs and only extrapolate remaining days from the completed-day baseline: projectedRevenue 24000, projected COGS 3900 (actual MTD 3200 + remaining 700), fees 1560, projectedNet 18540.
findings.actual: projectedNet is 20040 because the code applies the last-7 COGS rate to the entire projected month total, rewriting actual early-MTD COGS: "const observedCogsRate = last7Rev > 0 ? last7Cogs / last7Rev : COGS_RATE_OF_REVENUE;" and "const projectedNet = projectedRev - projectedSpend - projectedRev * observedCogsRate - projectedRev * observedFeesRate - projectedFixedCosts;"
findings.fix_sketch: Project variable costs as actual MTD totals plus remaining-day extrapolation: projectedCogs = mtdCogs + (last7Rev > 0 ? (last7Cogs / last7DaysCount) * daysRemaining : projectedRemainingRevenue * COGS_RATE_OF_REVENUE). Do the same for transaction fees if store fee mix can change. Then projectedNet = projectedRev - projectedSpend - projectedCogs - projectedFees - projectedFixedCosts.
findings.regression_test_idea: Add a forecastMonthEnd test with high-COGS early MTD rows outside [today-7,today-1] and low-COGS baseline rows; assert projectedNet uses actual MTD COGS plus baseline COGS for remaining days, not projectedRevenue * last7CogsRate.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No test covers projectedNet when early MTD COGS/fee mix differs from the last completed week.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: The current tests only use homogeneous baseline-shaped data or reconstruct the current last7Rate formula, so they miss projection errors that rewrite already-realized MTD cost history.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: One high-COGS row near month start plus seven low-COGS completed baseline rows, with expected projected cost = actual MTD cost + baseline daily cost * daysRemaining.

test_coverage_gaps.description: No tests cover detectAnomalies, generateRecommendations, insight state visibility, or cloud-synced goal/insight writes in this file.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: Algorithm changes outside forecastMonthEnd could emit or hide wrong insight cards without failing the current specified tests.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Fixtures for flat-baseline anomaly detection, zero-conversion campaign recommendations, store underperformance, done/ignored TTL visibility, and writeGoal immediate push behavior.

test_coverage_gaps.description: Forecast tests do not pin full-month projected fixed-cost behavior for multi-store All-scoped billing rows.
test_coverage_gaps.why_it_matters: GoalTracker is intentionally global; a regression in billing storeNames could double-count or under-count shared fixed costs in projectedNet.
test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: Seed an All recurring cost and two stores in rows, then assert projectedFixedCosts is charged once and split semantics match billingForRange.
